Marriage Test

Are You Ready to Get Married? Couple Marriage Test

Getting married is much more than a beautiful celebration. It's a life decision that commits two people for decades — with everything that implies: finances, children, daily life, values, disagreements. This marriage couple test is designed to help you verify that you've thought through all of this — together, honestly, before saying yes.

Why Take a Couple Test Before Marriage?

Address the Real Issues

Finances, children, values, intimacy — this test covers all the topics couples often avoid before the big day.

Open the Dialogue

Each question is an invitation to discuss honestly. The best conversations start here.

Measure Your Alignment

Discover if you're truly on the same page about the topics that make or break a marriage.

No Registration Required

100% free, confidential test with no signup. Your answers stay between you.

What This Test Really Evaluates

This marriage couple test doesn't evaluate the intensity of your love. It measures your alignment on concrete topics that make or break a life together:

  • How you manage money and financial disagreements
  • Your vision of children, education, and the role of your families
  • The balance of daily life and the distribution of the mental load
  • Your core values and relationship to spirituality
  • The quality of your communication and how you handle conflicts
  • Your life projects and ability to plan together

Topics Couples Avoid Before Marriage

Money tops the list. Children come right after. In-laws are another minefield. Career ambitions — all situations that can create real fractures if not anticipated together.

Also discover our quiz to test your couple compatibility to evaluate your overall relationship, or our test to find out if your relationship is healthy.

Is a Disagreement a Problem?

No. A disagreement isn't a problem — it's reality. What matters is the ability to work through it.

Not a problemWorth attention
Having different views on a topicRefusing to discuss it
Disagreeing on number of childrenNever having brought it up
Having different spending habitsHiding finances from each other
Having different desire levelsNever talking about it
Having complicated familiesLeaving the other to deal alone

Marriage Takes Real Preparation

This marriage couple test is a starting point, not a conclusion. Try our AI-powered tool to resolve your couple conflicts to go further.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can this test predict marriage success?
No test can. Marriage is an unpredictable human adventure. This test highlights blind spots you haven't explored yet and gives you a reason to have important conversations.
Does skipping questions affect the result?
No. Skipped questions are excluded from the calculation. Your score is based only on answered questions. That said, if you skip a question because it's uncomfortable, it might be the one you need to discuss most.
Is this test free and confidential?
Yes, 100%. No registration, no email required. Your answers are not saved and stay only on your device.
